source: West Orange, NJ Patch: "Here's How Many Students Attend Each West Orange School" (Eric Kiefer, published April 10, 2026), reporting figures released by West Orange Public Schools administrators at a March 26, 2026 Board of Education budget presentation.
note: This is a single current snapshot, not a year-by-year series. It does not exactly match the 2024-25 academic year that is the most recent year in wops-performance.json; treat any comparison across the two as approximate by about one school year, not an exact match. Full historical enrollment by school (2015-16 through 2024-25) is not yet included; NJDOE publishes this only as one downloadable Excel file per year (nj.gov/education/doedata/enr), not as an easily automatable per-school-per-year lookup.
